name: PostgreSQL
queryCode: SELECT      t1.CREATEDATE,      t1.CREATEMAN,      t1.CREATEMANNAME,      t11.DCSYSTEMID,      t31.DCSYSTEMNAME,      t11.GLOBALFLAG,      t1.ISVALID,      t21.LOGINNAME,      t21.MDEPTID,      t21.MDEPTNAME,      t21.ORGID,      t21.ORGNAME,      t21.PERSONNAME,      t11.ROLETAG,      t21.SHOWORDER,      t1.SYS_ROLEID,      t11.SYS_ROLENAME,      t1.SYS_USER_ROLEID,      t1.UPDATEDATE,      t1.UPDATEMAN,      t1.UPDATEMANNAME,      t1.USERID,      t11.USERMODE  FROM (select CREATE_TIME as  CREATEDATE,               CREATOR as CREATEMAN,               CREATOR as CREATEMANNAME,ROLE_ID as SYS_ROLEID, ID as SYS_USER_ROLEID,               UPDATE_TIME as  UPDATEDATE,               UPDATER as UPDATEMAN,               UPDATER as UPDATEMANNAME,               MEMBER_UID as USERID,1 as  ISVALID,MEMBER_UID,MEMBER_TYPE,ROLE_ID from sys_role_member ) t1           LEFT JOIN IBZROLE t11 ON t1.ROLE_ID = t11.SYS_ROLEID           LEFT JOIN (select  id,UID as LOGINNAME,                              MDEPARTMENT_ID as MDEPTID,                              MDEPARTMENT_ID as MDEPTNAME,                              ORGANIZATION_ID as ORGID,                              ORGANIZATION_ID as  ORGNAME,0 as  SHOWORDER,                              DISPLAY_NAME as PERSONNAME from sys_person ) t21 ON t1.MEMBER_UID = t21.id and t1.MEMBER_TYPE='inetOrgPerson'           LEFT JOIN IBZDCSYSTEM t31 ON t11.DCSYSTEMID = t31.DCSYSTEMID
